name: D1Bound5.finitePHalfRemainder_norm_le
original_signature:
(n : ℕ) (z : ℂ)
    (hn : 6 ≤ n) (hz : ‖z‖ < 1) :
    ‖finiteQHalfRemainder n z‖ ≤ (21/1024 : ℝ)*‖z‖^n/(1-‖z‖)

name: D1Bound5.finitePPairResidual_eq_leading_tail
original_signature:
(u v c : ℂ)
    (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (kind : Fin 2) :
    finitePPairResidual u v c kind =
      ![finitePLeadingR u v,finitePLeadingT u v] kind/c^5+finitePPairTail u v c kind
explicit_arguments: u v c hu hv hc kind

name: D1Bound5.finitePResidual_eq_pairs
original_signature:
(a b s c : ℂ) (i : Fin 4) :
    finitePResidual a b s c i =
      ![finitePPairResidual a b c 0,
        finitePPairResidual a b c 0+finitePPairResidual b s c 0-finitePPairResidual a s c 0,
        finitePPairResidual a b c 1,finitePPairResidual a s c 1-finitePPairResidual b s c 1] i

name: D1Bound5.finitePResidual_eq_leading_tail
original_signature:
(a b s c : ℂ)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (i : Fin 4) :
    finitePResidual a b s c i = finitePLeading a b s i/c^5+finitePTail a b s c i
explicit_arguments: a b s c ha hb hs hc i

name: D1Bound5.finitePLeading_eq_terms
original_signature:
(a b s : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hs : s ≠ 0) (i : Fin 4) :
    finitePLeading a b s i =
      (∑ t, finitePLeadingTermValue ![a,b,s] (finitePLeadingTerms i t))/256
explicit_arguments: a b s ha hb hs i

name: D1Bound5.finitePLeadingTerms_exponents
original_signature:
(i : Fin 4) (t : Fin 12) :
    let u := finitePLeadingTerms i t
    u.2.2.2.1 ≤ 2 ∧ u.2.2.2.1+3 ≤ u.2.2.2.2+2

name: D1Bound5.finitePLeading_norm_le
original_signature:
(a b s : ℂ)
    (hA : 1 ≤ ‖a‖) (hAB : ‖a‖ ≤ ‖b‖) (hBS : ‖b‖ ≤ ‖s‖) (i : Fin 4) :
    ‖finitePLeading a b s i‖ ≤ (35/16 : ℝ)*‖s‖^2/‖a‖^3
explicit_arguments: a b s hA hAB hBS i

name: D1Bound5.finitePTailCoeffTerms_admissible
original_signature:
(kind side : Fin 2) (l t : Fin 3) :
    (finitePTailCoeffTerms kind side l t).2.2 ≤ 2 ∧
      (finitePTailCoeffTerms kind side l t).2.1+
        (finitePTailCoeffTerms kind side l t).2.2 ≤ 3+(l : ℕ)

name: D1Bound5.finitePTailCoeffWeight_sum
original_signature:
(kind : Fin 2) :
    (∑ side : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 3, finitePTailCoeffWeight kind side l) =
      ![876,2676] kind

name: D1Bound5.finitePPairCoeff_eq_terms
original_signature:
(u v : ℂ) (kind side : Fin 2) (l : Fin 3) :
    finitePPairCoeff u v kind side l =
      ∑ t : Fin 3, ((finitePTailCoeffTerms kind side l t).1 : ℂ)*
        (![u,v] side)^(finitePTailCoeffTerms kind side l t).2.1*
        (![v,u] side)^(finitePTailCoeffTerms kind side l t).2.2

name: D1Bound5.finitePPairCoeff_norm_le
original_signature:
(u v : ℂ) (A S : ℝ)
    (hA1 : 1 ≤ A) (hAu : A ≤ ‖u‖) (hAv : A ≤ ‖v‖)
    (huS : ‖u‖ ≤ S) (hvS : ‖v‖ ≤ S)
    (kind side : Fin 2) (l : Fin 3) :
    ‖finitePPairCoeff u v kind side l‖ ≤
      (finitePTailCoeffWeight kind side l : ℝ)*(S^2/A^4)*
        ‖![u,v] side‖^(5+(l : ℕ))
explicit_arguments: u v A S hA1 hAu hAv huS hvS kind side l

name: D1Bound5.finitePPairTail_norm_le
original_signature:
(u v c : ℂ) (A S : ℝ)
    (hA1 : 1 ≤ A) (hAu : A ≤ ‖u‖) (hAv : A ≤ ‖v‖)
    (huS : ‖u‖ ≤ S) (hvS : ‖v‖ ≤ S) (hAC : 1000 ≤ A*‖c‖) (kind : Fin 2) :
    ‖finitePPairTail u v c kind‖ ≤ (![876,2676] kind : ℕ)*
      ((21/1024 : ℝ)*(1000/999)*S^2/(A^4*‖c‖^6))
explicit_arguments: u v c A S hA1 hAu hAv huS hvS hAC kind

name: D1Bound5.finitePTail_norm_lt
original_signature:
(a b s c : ℂ)
    (hA : 1 ≤ ‖a‖) (hAB : ‖a‖ ≤ ‖b‖) (hBS : ‖b‖ ≤ ‖s‖)
    (hAC : 1000 ≤ ‖a‖*‖c‖) (i : Fin 4) :
    ‖finitePTail a b s c i‖ < (1/8 : ℝ)*‖s‖^2/(‖a‖^3*‖c‖^5)
explicit_arguments: a b s c hA hAB hBS hAC i
